newsitem.title: USA: Sun TV stock tumbles after Gregg ends takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Sun TV stock tumbles after Gregg ends takeover bid.

text.p: The stock of Sun Television & Appliances Inc. fell sharply Monday after Gregg Appliances Inc. dropped its previously announced offer to acquire the appliance and electronics retailer.
The stock fell $2.25, or about 48 percent, to $2.50 on Nasdaq in early afternoon trading.
Sun said Friday that Gregg, an Indiana-based competitor, terminated its $5-a-share offer made on Dec. 11, after a review of Sun's preliminary third-quarter operating results.
Columbus, Ohio-based Sun said it expected to report a larger-than-expected fiscal 1997 third-quarter net loss of about $3.9 million to $4.2 million, or 22 cents to 24 cents per share.
Sun's third-quarter results are due the week of Dec. 29.
